name: bbms
description: Blood bank management and emergency blood coordination platform

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c red,blue "npm run dev -w @bbms/backend" "npm run dev -w @bbms/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @bbms/backend && npm run build -w @bbms/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @bbms/shared && npm run test -w @bbms/backend && npm run test -w @bbms/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
